name: Havoc in the Highlands

angles.text: As a shaman, you know Al'Aketh Stormcallers and their summoned Living Lightning wield the elements. The cultists twist wind and storm into weapons of fanatical aggression.

aliases: what is havoc in the highlands
faq.answer: Shen'dar Village strikes first against Al'Aketh cultists in the ruins of Falaath Village. Its defenders hope to stop an assault before it begins.
faq.q: What is Havoc in the Highlands?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh threaten Shen'dar Village. They worship elemental storms and field Stormcallers, bound Living Lightning, and Commander Cyclas, their leader.
The cultists gather in the ruins of Falaath Village. Commander Cyclas and his Al'Aketh followers use it as their staging ground.
Commander Cyclas leads the Al'Aketh forces gathered in the ruins of Falaath Village. They prepare to march on Shen'dar.
Sania Silverstream slips out of Shen'dar Village just before its defenders rally. She likely flees after seeing the locals take up arms and organize their defense.
faq.q: Why did Sania Silverstream flee Shen'dar Village?

faq.answer: Shen'dar Village turns back the immediate threat by breaking the cultists' forward ranks and beheading Commander Cyclas. Returning zealots will find the highlands ready to resist.
faq.q: Does the strike successfully secure Shen'dar Village?

sections.body: Zealous cultists are preparing to assault Shen'dar Village. So its leaders send you into the ruins of Falaath Village to strike first, before the Al'Aketh forces can begin their attack.
sections.title: A Preemptive Strike

sections.body: Al'Aketh zealots gather at Falaath Village and wield chaotic elemental power. You break their ranks by defeating Al'Aketh Stormcallers and shattering Living Lightning. Then you find Commander Cyclas and behead him.
sections.title: Assault on Falaath Village

sections.body: Commander Cyclas is slain, and his vanguard lies devastated. Shen'dar Village gains a vital reprieve. As the citizens take up arms, Sania Silverstream slips out of town unnoticed. She flees while the local defense gathers strength.
sections.title: Securing the Highlands

summary: In the highlands, Shen'dar Village moves against Al'Aketh forces at Falaath Village. Its defenders mean to stop an assault before it begins and protect their home.
attribution: In-game quest text: Havoc in the Highlands
